summary: Initial research acquisition script and stdout recovered verbatim from execution transcript. TLS verification, HTTPS enforcement, official domain whitelist, anonymous session, requests-level 20s timeout, max 2 redirects, and 2 MiB byte limits are confirmed in recovered code. However, the recovered script did not implement a hard process-level supervisor (such as SIGALRM or asyncio timeout wrapping redirects and response body streaming), and trust_env=False did not explicitly disable the requests.Session cookie jar across redirects. Additionally, initial manifest schema omitted explicit boolean eof_complete and discrete attempt counters. Per R3.1.2 instructions, no synthetic values are invented; historical acquisition proof is honestly declared PARTIAL. The offline statement extractor operates purely on saved bytes and does not rely on or claim runtime acquisition completeness.
